stage_rules.law: Invoke V556 only when an exact governed higher-order interaction/topology/prerequisite use is required; otherwise emit zero V556 objects.
Every governed V556 evaluation resolves one immutable semantic rule authority by exact ID/version/content hash; latest/fuzzy/label substitution is forbidden.
Every governed V556 evaluation binds 2..n exact canonical V555 route references and every positive V556 object names the exact participant bindings.
V556 never mints, reconstructs, aliases, normalizes, or copies a replacement semantic identity for a V555 route.
Participant roles, order, cardinality, multiplicity, and same-route reuse are controlled only by the exact V556 rule authority.
Cross-source composition requires exact operation-specific positive compatibility/composition authority; provenance or co-location never suffices.
Supported, valid-empty, denied, noncomparable, unknown-authority, conflicting-authority, invalid-participant, and unresolvable-participant states remain distinct.
A V556 producer object may be proposed directly to V557; V557 alone owns publication/use governance and may only narrow producer permission.
No V556 object is created solely to forward V555 semantics or preserve numeric stage order.
Shared endpoint, time, geography, stratum, storage adjacency, co-resolution, labels, or provenance never establish a V556 relation.

typed_states.SUPPORTED: Exact rule evaluated positively over an admissible participant set under all required authorities.
typed_states.VALID_EMPTY: Exact rule was lawfully evaluated and governed higher-order result is empty/none; not missing data and not a positive relation.
typed_states.DENIED: Exact governing authority denies the proposed higher-order semantic.
typed_states.NONCOMPARABLE: Required source/participant compatibility is explicitly noncomparable.
typed_states.UNKNOWN_AUTHORITY: Required rule/composition/participant authority is missing, unresolved, out of scope, mutable-latest, or not hash-bound.
typed_states.CONFLICTING_AUTHORITY: Applicable exact authorities conflict and no exact precedence rule resolves them.
typed_states.UNRESOLVABLE_PARTICIPANT: An exact V555 participant reference cannot be deterministically resolved or hash-validated.

missing_positive_output_semantics: NONE; missing positive output is not silently VALID_EMPTY, DENIED, or absence

Carry exact producer object/reference closure and producer permission ceiling to V557 when proposal is allowed.
